decisions.reason: Removing the referenced section's final paragraph does not change the separate constraint excluding unintended newline-marker text from the book title.
The paragraph deletion changes final manuscript content but does not alter the copyediting goal or either approved passage recorded by this Requirement.
The source does not identify the deleted paragraph as back matter or author-biography content, so the required back matter and author lines remain unchanged.
Deleting a manuscript paragraph does not affect chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The source removes content from one section but does not resume or modify the deferred paragraph-spacing and page-density Requirement.
The paragraph deletion does not change the permitted image source, suitability review, or illustration-selection criteria.
The source requests removal of a paragraph and does not change italic styling or quotation-mark treatment for Mama's Hot Take sections.
The deletion does not affect Chapter 18's first-line subtitle formatting.
Although deleting content could eventually alter pagination, the source does not change the existing requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after the book size is fixed.
Removing a paragraph from an interior manuscript section does not change the cover image, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover-design choice.
